systems.system: StatEduc integrated with DHIS2 (education management information system)
systems.owner: Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, with the University of Oslo and HISP West and Central Africa
systems.tiers: central departments, regional officers and education inspectorates; school observation data captured on Android devices

note: GPE KIX blog on the education ministry's data system; its 'districts' are the ministry's own inspectorates and regional offices, not local governments, so it gives no fact on a local government office's connection.
